Code for building an expanded reference panel for imprived MID genetic ancestry prediction.
This code merges HGDP+1kGP joint call set (Koenig et al. 2024) with WGS data from seven Middle Eastern countries (Almarri et al. 2021). 

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = FALSE, engine = "bash")
```

# Pre-process WGS reference cohorts

## HGDP-1kGP

Concatenate per-chromosome VCFs into one file, convert to PLINK format, then run basic
call-rate QC and remove related/outlier/contaminated samples.

```{bash hgdp1kgp}
# Variables — set these to your own paths
plink2=/path/to/plink2
hgdp1kgp=/path/to/reference_panels/hgdp1kgp/hgdp1kgp

# concatenate per-chromosome VCFs
ls ${hgdp1kgp}/*chr*.vcf.gz > hgdp1kgp.list
bcftools concat --file-list hgdp1kgp.list -O z -o ${hgdp1kgp}.vcf.gz

# index
bcftools index ${hgdp1kgp}.vcf.gz

# convert to plink
$plink2 \
--vcf $hgdp1kgp --make-bed \
--out $hgdp1kgp

# update sample IDs
$plink2 \
--bfile $hgdp1kgp \
--update-ids old_to_new_ids.txt --make-bed --out $hgdp1kgp
# 14,513,665 variants; 4,091 samples

# QC: variant call rate
$plink2 \
--bfile $hgdp1kgp --keep-allele-order --geno 0.1 --make-bed --out ${hgdp1kgp}qc1
# 0 variants removed

# QC: sample call rate
$plink2 \
--bfile ${hgdp1kgp}qc1 --keep-allele-order --mind 0.1 --make-bed --out ${hgdp1kgp}qc
# 0 samples removed
rm *qc*

# remove related, outlier, and contaminated samples (list from Koenig et al. 2024)
$plink2 \
--bfile ${hgdp1kgp} \
--keep-allele-order \
--set-all-var-ids chr@:#:\$r:\$a \
--remove related_outliers.txt --make-bed --out ${hgdp1kgp}_unrelated
# 3,398 samples

# write snplist
$plink2 \
--bfile ${hgdp1kgp}_unrelated \
--write-snplist --out ${hgdp1kgp}_unrelated

# write allele frequencies
$plink2 \
--bfile ${hgdp1kgp}_unrelated \
--freq --out ${hgdp1kgp}_unrelated
```

## Almarri

Normalize and filter the Almarri VCF, convert to PLINK, then filter on MAF and remove
duplicate variants.

```{bash almarri}
plink2=/path/to/plink2
fasta=/path/to/reference_genomes/b38/Homo_sapiens_assembly38.fasta
vcf=~/midProject/data/reference/cohorts/almarri2021/phased_variants_merged.vcf.gz

# normalize and split multiallelics
bcftools norm -c ws -m -snps -m -indels --fasta-ref $fasta -o ${vcf}_norm.vcf.gz -Oz $vcf

# keep PASS-filter variants only
bcftools view -f PASS -o ${vcf}_normPASS.vcf.gz -Oz ${vcf}_norm.vcf.gz

# check VCF stats
bcftools stats ${vcf}_normPASS.vcf.gz > ${vcf}_normPASS.vcf.stats
bcftools index ${vcf}_normPASS.vcf.gz

# set missing genotypes to reference allele (VCFs were generated separately)
bcftools +missing2ref ${vcf}_normPASS.vcf.gz -Oz -o ${vcf}_normPASSref.vcf.gz

# convert to plink, autosomes only, biallelic SNPs
$plink2 \
--keep-allele-order \
--vcf ${vcf}_normPASSref.vcf.gz --update-sex ids.txt \
--snps-only 'just-acgt' --chr 1-22 \
-max-alleles 2 \
--fa $fasta \
--make-bed --out ${vcf}_normPASSref
# 20,257,309 variants

# standardize variant IDs and sample names
$plink2 \
--keep-allele-order \
--bfile ${vcf}_normPASSref \
--fa $fasta \
--set-all-var-ids chr@:#:\$r:\$a \
--update-ids newIDs.txt \
--make-bed --out ${vcf}_normPASSref

# filter low minor-allele-frequency variants
$plink2 --bfile ${vcf}_normPASSref \
  --keep-allele-order \
  --maf 0.01 \
  --make-bed \
  --out ${vcf}_normPASSref01maf
# 9,578,100 variants

# remove duplicate variants
$plink2 \
--bfile ${vcf}_normPASSref01maf \
--keep-allele-order \
--rm-dup force-first --make-bed --out ${vcf}_normPASSref01maf
# 9,578,053 variants

# write snplist
$plink2 \
--bfile ${vcf}_normPASSref01maf --keep-allele-order --rm-dup --write-snplist --out ${vcf}_normPASSref01maf

# write allele frequencies
$plink2 \
--bfile ${vcf}_normPASSref01maf \
--keep-allele-order \
--freq --out ${vcf}_normPASSref01maf
```

# Merge reference cohorts

Intersect the SNP lists between cohorts, then merge on the shared variant set.

```{bash merge}
plink1=/path/to/plink_v1.9/plink
plink2=/path/to/plink2

export TMPDIR=/tmp
cohort1=~/midProject/data/reference/cohorts/almarri2021/phased_variants_merged_normPASSref01maf
cohort2=~/midProject/data/reference/cohorts/hgdp1kgp/hgdp1kgp_unrelated
snps=~/midProject/data/reference/cohorts/training/almarri_hgdp1kgp_unrelated.intersect
cohort=~/midProject/data/reference/cohorts/training/almarri_hgdp1kgp

# 1. intersect SNP lists between cohorts
comm -12 <(sort ${cohort1}.snplist) <(sort ${cohort2}.snplist) > $snps
# 7,761,449 variants

# 2. merge cohorts on the shared variant set
echo $cohort1 > almarri_hgdp1kgp.mergelist
echo $cohort2 >> almarri_hgdp1kgp.mergelist

$plink1 \
--merge-list almarri_hgdp1kgp.mergelist \
--extract $snps --keep-allele-order \
--make-bed --out $cohort
# 7,761,449 variants; 3,535 samples

# relabel Almarri population code to MID
awk -v OFS=" " '/^\[almarri\]/ {$1 = "MID"} {print}' ${cohort}.fam > tmp
mv tmp ${cohort}.fam
```

# QC after merge

Remove related individuals, filter to autosomal biallelic SNVs with MAF between 0.05–0.95
and call rate < 0.1% missing, exclude the MHC region, then LD-prune.

```{bash post-merge-qc}
plink1=/path/to/plink_v1.9/plink
plink2=/path/to/plink2

cohort=~/midProject/data/reference/cohorts/training/almarri_hgdp1kgp

# identify related samples
$plink2 --bfile ${cohort} \
  --keep-allele-order \
  --king-cutoff 0.088 \
  --out ${cohort}
# one sample excluded

$plink2 --bfile ${cohort} \
  --keep-allele-order \
  --remove ${cohort}.king.cutoff.out.id \
  --make-bed --out ${cohort}qc1
# 3,534 samples

$plink2 --bfile ${cohort}qc1 \
  --keep-allele-order \
  --snps-only 'just-acgt' \
  --max-alleles 2 \
  --autosome \
  --maf 0.05 \
  --max-maf 0.95 \
  --make-bed \
  --out ${cohort}qc2
# 5,237,676 variants (0.05 maf)

# exclude low call-rate variants
$plink2 --bfile ${cohort}qc2 \
  --keep-allele-order \
  --geno 0.1 \
  --make-bed \
  --out ${cohort}qc3
# 0 variants removed due to missing genotype data

# exclude low call-rate samples
$plink2 --bfile ${cohort}qc2 \
  --keep-allele-order \
  --mind 0.1 \
  --make-bed \
  --out ${cohort}qc3
# 0 samples removed due to missing genotype data

# exclude the MHC region (chr6:28,510,120-33,480,577)
awk -F'\t' '$1 == 6 {split($2, pos, ":"); if (pos[2] >= 28510120 && pos[2] <= 33480577) print}' ${cohort}qc2.bim | cut -f 2 > ${cohort}.mhc
$plink2 \
--bfile ${cohort}qc2 --exclude ${cohort}.mhc --keep-allele-order --make-bed --out ${cohort}qc3
# 5,210,630 variants remaining

# LD prune (parameters follow Almarri et al. 2021)
$plink2 \
--bfile ${cohort}qc3 \
--indep-pairwise 50 5 0.5 \
--keep-allele-order \
--out ${cohort}qc3

# apply pruning
$plink2 --bfile ${cohort}qc3 \
  --extract ${cohort}qc3.prune.in \
  --keep-allele-order \
  --make-bed \
  --out ${cohort}qc
# 833,878 variants

# write snplist
$plink2 \
--bfile ${cohort}qc --write-snplist --out ${cohort}qc

# write allele frequencies
$plink2 \
--bfile ${cohort}qc --freq --out ${cohort}qc
```

# Convert to hg37 (for UKBB prediction)

Liftover the merged, QC'd panel from hg38 to hg37/hg19 so it's compatible with UK Biobank
genotype data.

```{bash liftover}
module load java/jdk-22
module load bcftools

plink2=/path/to/plink2
cohort=~/midProject/data/reference/cohorts/training/almarri_hgdp1kgpqc

# specify build conversion: hg18, hg19(hg37), hg38
from=38
to=19
hg=37

hgdp1kgp=$(echo $cohort | sed "s/.*\///g")
path=$(echo $cohort | sed "s/\/$hgdp1kgp$//g")

# reference genome for the TARGET build
fasta38=/path/to/reference_genomes/b38/Homo_sapiens_assembly38.fasta
fasta19=/path/to/reference_genomes/hg19/hg19.fa
varname="fasta${to}"
fasta="${!varname}"
chain=/path/to/genetic_maps/liftover/hg${from}ToHg${to}.over.chain.gz
vcf=$cohort.vcf
chr=/path/to/project/reference/cohorts/chr_hgdp1kgp_conv.txt

# 1. convert to VCF
$plink2 \
--bfile $cohort --snps-only 'just-acgt' --recode vcf --out $cohort

bcftools annotate --rename-chrs $chr -o $vcf.gz -Oz --write-index $vcf

# 2. liftover with Picard
java -jar /path/to/picard/picard.jar \
LiftoverVcf --CHAIN $chain \
--INPUT ${vcf}.gz \
--OUTPUT ${cohort}_hg${hg}.vcf.gz \
--REFERENCE_SEQUENCE $fasta \
--RECOVER_SWAPPED_REF_ALT \
--REJECT ${path}/unlifted_tohg${hg}_${hgdp1kgp}.vcf \
--WARN_ON_MISSING_CONTIG \
--DISABLE_SORT

# 3. convert back to plink
$plink2 \
--vcf ${cohort}_hg${hg}.vcf.gz \
--snps-only 'just-acgt' --allow-extra-chr --chr 1-22 \
--keep-allele-order \
--set-all-var-ids chr@:#:\$r:\$a --sort-vars \
--make-pgen \
--out ${cohort}_hg${hg}

# fix sample IDs after VCF conversion
less ${cohort}.fam | awk -v OFS="\t" '{print "0", $1"_"$2, $1, $2}' > ${path}/id_${hgdp1kgp}.txt

$plink2 \
--pfile ${cohort}_hg${hg} \
--keep-allele-order \
--update-ids ${path}/id_${hgdp1kgp}.txt --make-bed --out ${cohort}_hg${hg}

# 5. write snplist
$plink2 \
--keep-allele-order \
--bfile ${cohort}_hg${hg} --write-snplist --out ${cohort}_hg${hg}
```
